title: John Alexander's book finds no Majestic group

tellings.quote: his book about UFOs, he claims that he never found any group like Majestic

plain: John B. Alexander, a researcher who looked into UFOs, says in his book on the subject that he never found any group like "Majestic", a secret committee long rumoured to control the UFO matter inside the US government. The philosopher Jason Jorjani sums up the book on the show without quoting it, and also brings up the French UFO researcher Jacques Vallée. It matters because it would mean someone who searched found no sign of the rumoured group.
